title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
summary: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.

title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
summary: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
summary: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

title: Bitcoin rebound already losing steam as AI trade returns with a bang
summary: Nvidia jumped more than 30% and has recovered most of its losses since CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but bitcoin is lagging as U.S. selling persists, traders said.

title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest pulls the plug on two planned crypto ETFs
summary: ProShares' rival CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF (KRYP) holds $1.81 million in assets nearly 10 months post-launch.
